svg.title: Enterprise AI Platform on AWS: architecture
svg.text: Enterprise AI Platform on AWS · architecture (dev environment)
The caller selects one backend per request · no automatic routing or fallback
Request and inference path · the caller names one backend per request
On-prem path · implemented, no successful end-to-end request yet
Supporting integrations · RAG on request; tools and writes when the model asks
Steps: 1 token · 2 call the API · 3 invoke · 4 selected backend.
Every request opens an MCP session to AgentCore.
Lambda egress to AWS APIs goes through the EC2 router's NAT.
No routing, retries or failover between backends.
